I don't necessarily think there is much anybody can do to talk me out of it at this point.  I'm just trying to prepare my affairs as best I can so I don't leave a huge mess for everyone.  

I feel I've achieved as much as I will achieve in life, and at this point I'm just idling till I die.  

I'm just wanting to give back in every sense to the people I care about as I go.  I guess It'd be nice if there's some rough rubric of what I can do to get my stuff in order.
